outputs.explanation: Panel A is a western blot (protein bands), not a plot of averaged data; no individual-points requirement applies.
Panel B consists of phase-contrast micrographs of cell colonies, not a plot of averaged data.

The top flow-cytometry density plots are raw single-cell data (scatter-type, exempt from needing overlay). The bottom bar chart summarizing % cells shows individual replicate data points (distinct circle/square/triangle markers) plotted over each bar, consistent with n=3.
The top flow-cytometry plots are raw single-cell scatter data (exempt). The bottom bar chart (PI-/Annexin V-) displays individual replicate data points overlaid on each of the three bars (n=3).
Panel E is a heatmap of Z-scored gene expression; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel F is a western blot showing protein levels, not an averaged plot.
Both bar charts (pluripotency genes left, lineage marker genes right) show individual replicate data points (circle/square/triangle markers) overlaid on each bar, consistent with n=3.
Panel H shows immunofluorescence micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
